cases.question: A school buys 3 packs of 6 pencils each. It uses 16 pencils, then buys 7 more packs of 3 pencils each. How many unused pencils does it have?
A museum has 11 boxes of cards with 6 cards in each box. It receives 3 bundles with 3 cards in each bundle, then gives away 14 cards. How many cards does it have now?
A museum has 11 boxes of cards with 5 cards in each box. It receives 6 bundles with 3 cards in each bundle, then gives away 11 cards. How many cards does it have now?
A workshop makes 14 parts per hour for 3 hours. It marks 1 as defective and completes 2 orders of 3 parts each. How many usable parts are left after the orders?

A school buys 4 packs of 9 pencils each. It uses 10 pencils, then buys 9 more packs of 9 pencils each. How many unused pencils does it have?

Three reading rooms start with 15, 57, and 15 books in Oak, Birch, and Maple, respectively. How many books are in Birch at the end?
